summary.text: Jerry Nadler represents New York's 12th Congressional District; he was elected to the U.S. House in a 1992 special election and has served since.

paragraphs.text: He began his public service in 1976 as a member of the New York State Assembly, where he served for 16 years, and chaired the House Judiciary Committee from 2019 to 2023.
He is a graduate of Stuyvesant High School, Columbia University and Fordham Law School and lives on Manhattan's Upper West Side.
